concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-account-balances-next-payout]] — 2023-modified, 2026-09-15-captured Adyen guide to a merchant account's changing Next payout balance, expense-driven negatives, possible refund/payout/deposit effects, and conditional Reserve auto-funding or top-up/transfer routes; balance is not bank receipt.
warnings: Do not treat Next payout as a fixed positive amount, infer payout frequency/date/currency from this page, or infer that conditional auto-funding, transfer or top-up completed.
